name: Beef Smash Tacos with Spicy Ketchup & Fennel-Arugula Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 fennel bulbs
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a large bowl. Add oil, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place ketchup, water, Worcestershire, and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine the spicy ketchup and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup ketchup
3 tbsp water
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince shallots. Place in another large bowl, along with beef and spices, then mix with your hands until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 shallots
1.02 kg lean ground beef
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Arrange tortillas on a flat surface, then divide the beef mixture between them (about 3 tablespoons per tortilla). Using a knife (or your hands), spread the beef mixture over the surface of each tortilla in an even layer.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add tacos, meat-side down. Cook, pressing down once with the bottom of a spatula halfway through cooking, until the beef is cooked through, about 3 minutes.
Flip tacos, beef-side up, and continue to cook until tortillas are golden underneath, 1 minute more. Transfer to a plate and carefully fold in half to form tacos.

Meanwhile, trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulbs. Halve fennel bulbs lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with arugula, and toss to combine the salad.
Divide tacos and salad between plates. Serve with spicy ketchup on the side and enjoy!
